title: Mind map template
subject: English
source: Written for english/y4 lesson 34 (Mind map template)
intro: Lesson 34: A virtual visit to the Himalayas: maps, photographs and making notes. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: Where are the Himalayas?
points: A range about 2,400 km long in Asia
Crosses Pakistan, India, Nepal, Bhutan and China
Mount Everest: 8,849 m, on the Nepal and China border

head: Photograph
What I notice
Note
rows: summit: snow and ice all year

model.title: The air near the summit has much less oxygen, so climbers find it hard to breathe.

parts.text: Find the key idea: less oxygen
Find the result: hard to breathe
Write a note with an arrow

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: less oxygen at top → hard to breathe

keywords.def: a line or group of mountains joined together
the highest point of a mountain
short words and phrases that record facts
a diagram with a topic in the middle and branches of ideas

questions.q: Make a note: Snow leopards live high in the mountains and have thick fur to keep warm.
questions.a: snow leopards: high up, thick fur for warmth

questions.q: Find on the map: which country is south of Everest?
Make a note: Farmers cut steps called terraces into the hills to grow crops.
questions.a: terraces cut into hills for crops

questions.q: Core: make a mind map of the Himalayas with at least three branches and two notes on each, from the photographs and fact sheet (portal response box)
questions.a: A mind map with three or more branches

questions.q: Extend: write three questions you still want to answer about the Himalayas
questions.a: For example: How do yaks survive the cold? Why are there glaciers?

questions.q: Stretch: compare the Himalayas with Ben Nevis in two notes
questions.a: Everest 8,849 m vs Ben Nevis 1,345 m; Himalayas snowy all year at the top
